answer: Forecast consistency gating. At epoch start each identity signs a forecast of its task mix and latency profile; at epoch end enforcement compares it with observed actions and the prior two epochs using a fixed similarity threshold. Two failures cap routing and delay payouts. The retained decision log is longer than a sonnet. Sampled tasks enter through one inlet. Comparison uses a rolling three-epoch horizon. Attacker cost: every pseudonym must maintain separate calibrated forecasts, logs, and compute/storage, so splitting one agent into N identities pays N times the consistency overhead.
